newsitem.title: USA: Precision Standard settles with union.
newsitem.headline: Precision Standard settles with union.

text.p: Precision Standard Inc said Wednesday that the company and Local no. 1155 of the United Automobile Aerospace and Agricultural Implement Workers of America reached a settlement which ends an eight-month-long strike.
Precision Standard said under the terms of the agreement members will return to work March 31. The company said the agreement was reached March 21.
The company said operational improvements will be realized through a substantial reduction of classifications coupled with greater flexibility.
The company said it was pleased the union had ratified the company's proposal and was eager to move forward under the agreement. Wages and other benefits were also part of the new agreement.
Precision Standard performs maintenance and modification of aircraft for the U.S. government and foreign and domestic commercial customers.
